title: fix(multiaxis): the banded parallel retip read agrees with the envelope law on slanted skins
body:
## What the feature brings (#2774, brought to the current main)

A rotary operation may state its heights as radii about the fitted
rotation axis: `RadialHeight { source, offset }` - the stock OD, the
model's max radius, or an absolute radius - as `clearance_r`,
`retract_r`, `top_r`, `bottom_r` on Rotary Contour and Rotary Parallel
and `clearance_r` + `top_r` on Rotary Offset. `None` on every field
keeps the Z-plane law byte for byte; the `*_z` fields stay.

- Heights as radii: one resolver (`app::operation::radial_heights`)
  fits the same axis the generators pose about; the radial gate
  refuses, at create/edit/retype, a clearance or retract radius that
  stands inside the work or a band that crosses.
- Band windowing: Rotary Contour keeps whole rings by tip radius
  (`band_select`); Rotary Parallel trims each skin-following pass at
  the band edges (`band_trim`); Rotary Offset caps its rho ladder at
  the bottom radius. A band that crosses no part skin refuses by name
  at the generate.
- Wrap hand-off: a band whose cylinders cover the path's whole radial
  reach hands the base path on unchanged (commit 815075be7).
- Project ladder v84 -> v85: the radii are serde-default fields, a v84
  file steps up unchanged, and a v84 reader refuses a v85 file rather
  than drop the stated radii. The three held commits (9a4da2e5f,
  8f6e59d1e, 815075be7) are cherry-picked; the two obsolete v74
  commits of the held branch are dropped and their content redone as
  the current next rung.

## The #3490 diagnosis: the two reads, what disagreed

The verdict the branch could not shake:
`Envelope { at: 38, gouge_mm: 1.544, rest_mm: 0.096 }` on a radial
band 4.0..5.5 over the r6/r5 stepped bar - the post refused a legal
program.

Both reads were re-read side by side:

- The RETIP READ the band uses, `hypot(y, z + r) - r`, is the ball
  center's radius about the axis minus the ball - the emitted tip's
  radius under the radial pose. Instrumented against the verifier it
  is exact on every kept cut move: the pose on cuts is the radial
  (lead/lag 0), so the emitted tip and the read agree.
- The ENVELOPE LAW (`stock_sim::facet_gouge`) reconstructs each ball
  center exactly (tip lifted along the pose it holds) and measures
  the exact distance of each model triangle to it. It is untouched.

What disagreed was neither read: the band trim's kept-stretch join
GLUED touching spans by extending the previous output move's end -
two arc-fit chords of a run became one straight chord. On the
raster's wrap chains (the arc around the cone's edge, ball centers on
the radius-8.5 ring) the glued chord dips 1.46 mm below the arc the
base plan rode; the reconstructed ball there stands 1.4554 mm from
the cone facet - the 1.5446 mm gouge, move for move. The verifier was
right; the kept geometry was corrupted.

## The fix

Touching spans stay consecutive Feed records (`radial_band.rs`). The
relink already reads consecutive non-lift Feeds as one run, so the
spans keep one cut - never a link between them - and the run's
polyline survives with every corner. The envelope law is untouched.

## Pins

- `rotary_verify::the_stated_radial_heights_move_the_generated_path`:
  red at the held branch with the reported verdict, green here.
- The correct-refusal side stands: a band that crosses no part skin
  refuses by name at the generate
  (`a_band_that_crosses_no_skin_is_refused_by_name`,
  `a_parallel_band_that_crosses_no_skin_is_refused_by_name`), and a
  gouging path still blocks the post.
- Motion band tests: `the_parallel_band_cuts_between_two_cylinders`,
  `a_band_that_wraps_the_whole_skin_adds_no_links`.

## Gates

- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion`: 161 suites, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim`: 98 suites, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app`: 84 suites, 0 failed (incl. the lib
  suite, the v85 round trip and the project-version suites).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1764 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui
  --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

## Not exercised

A real machine run. The banded parallel's posted G-code is pinned by
the document-level test only (the verifier's own envelope law); no
cut was made on steel.

Unblocks #2774: with the retip read and the envelope law agreeing,
the held feature's last blocker is gone.

Changelog: Rotary Contour, Rotary Parallel and Rotary Offset read
their heights as radii about the fitted axis and window their cut
band by radii; a wrapping band no longer chops its passes; banded
parallel paths verify clean on slanted skins.

Fixes #3490



## Screenshots (the review's evidence, item 9)

The Heights tab and the viewport, before and after the feature - the
same turned bar, stock, tool and operation on both sides, captured
off-screen through the guide-images harness (page and viewport crops):

Before (the Z planes only, no radial rows, no rings):

- Page: https://github.com/FlamingFireCoding/Camcraft/raw/pr-screenshots/issue-3490/rotary-radial-before-page.png
- Viewport: https://github.com/FlamingFireCoding/Camcraft/raw/pr-screenshots/issue-3490/rotary-radial-before-viewport.png

After (the radial rows checked with their echoes, and the two rings
about the judged axis):

- Page: https://github.com/FlamingFireCoding/Camcraft/raw/pr-screenshots/issue-3490/rotary-radial-after-page.png
- Viewport: https://github.com/FlamingFireCoding/Camcraft/raw/pr-screenshots/issue-3490/rotary-radial-after-viewport.png

## Review rework (the nine requested findings)

Fixed on the branch in four commits; the review's own probes are
reproduced as tests:

1. Tip-to-center conversion (commit 167249f6b): the contour's radial
   relink now applies ONE tip-to-center conversion to every link (the
   ball center stands one ball radius outside the stated radius, the
   parallel twin's own law), so the posed tip stands AT the stated
   radius. Pinned by
   	he_stated_radii_are_the_tips_radii_on_every_link and the
   reviewer's app probe as
   	he_stated_contour_radii_clear_the_work (stated R8/R6.5 on the
   d12.4 bar verifies silent; it read Envelope { gouge_mm: 2.5 }
   before).
2. One-sided radial bands (commit 167249f6b):  and_window honors a
   Bottom radius alone (floor cylinder out to the skin's end) and a Top
   radius alone (axis out to the ceiling), for all three rotary kinds.
   Pinned by ^G_bottom_only_band_windows_the_parallel_passes,
   ^G_top_only_band_windows_the_parallel_passes,
   ^G_bottom_only_contour_band_windows_its_rings and the direct
   adial_band_tests.rs band-window pins.
3. Inclusive band edges (commit 167249f6b): each_band_span keeps
   constant and tangent spans with one closed-interval rule, so a span
   ON a band cylinder keeps both exact edges. The review's probe
   (constant span on the bottom cylinder beside a trimming span) is
   pinned in adial_band_tests.rs
   (^G_constant_span_on_the_bottom_cylinder_is_kept_to_its_end), with
   the start-edge, tangent, mixed enter/leave and whole-band pins
   beside it.
4. The selected rotary axis (commit 1009ddeb9): adial_context
   resolves the radii about the SAME axis generation turns about (the
   stated axis judged by ^Gxis_stated::judged_any, the free fit only
   when nothing is stated). The display cache keys the axis statement,
   the machine's work-turning rotary lines and the work offset origin.
   Pinned by ^G_stated_axis_resolves_the_radii_generation_judges (the
   R5 sphere fixture) and
   	he_radial_axis_cache_follows_a_new_axis_statement.
5. Radial input validation (commit 1009ddeb9): every set radial field is
   validated before storage - RadialHeight::is_sane keeps a finite
   offset and an absolute radius never under the axis, OpParams::is_sane
   checks each set field, and adial_gate surfaces the resolution
   failures it used to discard, with the range and ordering laws. The
   same door runs on create, edit, paste and retype. Pinned by
   ^G_radial_radius_that_is_no_radius_is_refused_at_the_command and
   ^G_radial_radius_its_source_cannot_answer_is_refused_by_name.
6. Radial overlay basis (commit 8fa787d07): the ring's second
   perpendicular is the unit dir x u (one orthonormal basis), never
   re-perpendicularized through off_axis. The plane and radius of
   every generated ring point are pinned for X, Y, Z and an oblique
   axis, and end to end through the overlay
   (	he_overlay_rings_stand_in_planes_about_the_judged_axis).
7. Valid zero-radius display (commit 8fa787d07): the echo displays the
   resolved zero for the field that permits it. The page test
   	he_default_bottom_radius_echoes_its_valid_zero drives the check
   row the way a user's click lands.
8. Project-format rollout (commit 1db582e7f): the committed example is
   regenerated by the suite's own WRITE_GOLDEN path; the diff is the
   version number and the operation stamp, and the committed .nc posts
   unchanged. See "Goldens moved" below. The compatibility break is
   declared with a BREAKING CHANGE: footer on that commit, and the
   decision entry identifies the current v85 step.
9. UI screenshots (this body): captured off-screen through the
   guide-images harness in detached worktrees, at the PR's base commit
   (before) and the rework head (after); the capture tests were
   uncommitted and deleted. The PNGs live only on the fork's
   pr-screenshots branch.

## Goldens moved

examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj: version 84 -> 85 and the
operation stamp refresh - no stored parameter, setup, machine or program
statement moved. examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.nc: unchanged
(the loaded project posts it move for move).
